steps.what: sugar, glucose syrup and butter to the cream
steps.note: Cream, sugar, glucose syrup and butter are cooked together.
The mix is cooked to the firm-ball stage, too cool to caramelise the sugar, so the milk browns instead.
It is spread thin on a water-cooled wheel and set.
Caramels are cut from a rope, not moulded, and wrapped one by one.
